nature_language: 当前位置深圳。我一个人想去上海玩2天，预算3500人民币，住一间单床房，坐飞机去，想去东方明珠看一下，请给我一个旅行规划。
nature_language_en: Current location: Shenzhen. I want to travel alone to Shanghai for 2 days with a budget of 3,500 RMB. I plan to stay in a single room and fly there. I would like to visit the Oriental Pearl Tower. Please provide me with a travel plan.
